race.comment: EL LAZZAR (5) worked to get to the lead and kept finding to salute last start over 1750m at Swan Hill, the second win from his past three appearances. Meets a comparable field so he can certainly make it two on the bounce. WICKED MITZI (1) finished sixth last start, beaten 8 metres at Shepparton over 1690m. Has ability and should be right in the finish. EMILY VINCENT (2) is in the mix following a fourth at her most recent appearance over 1690m at Kilmore. MAJOR MANBAR (4) ended last prep with a sixth at Bendigo over 2150m a year ago. Capable of a forward showing while fresh.
